# AI Ready Colombo

AI Ready Colombo is a free, self-paced practical AI literacy pilot for students, recent graduates and early-career professionals. It teaches learners how to use generative AI with clearer prompts, better verification, stronger privacy habits and human judgment.

## Core learning pages
- Home: /index.html
- Start and baseline: /start.html
- Module 1 — Understanding AI: /modules/module-1.html
- Module 2 — Working With AI / CTCO prompting: /modules/module-2.html
- Module 3 — AI for Real Work: /modules/module-3.html
- Module 4 — Responsible AI: /modules/module-4.html
- Module 5 — Build Your AI Workflow: /modules/module-5.html
- Your Data & AI: /privacy.html
- Toolkit: /toolkit.html
- Final assessment: /final-assessment.html
- Completion: /completion.html
- About: /about.html
- Privacy Notice: /privacy-notice.html
- AI Disclosure: /ai-disclosure.html

## Core framework
Define. Prompt. Inspect. Verify. Decide.

## Prompting framework
CTCO means Context, Task, Constraints and Output.

## Toolkit
The downloadable toolkit contains six practical guides plus a contents sheet covering AI basics, prompt templates, verification, privacy, study workflows and job search.
